propositions: A provider-neutral mapping config module must parse `[tool.rebar.mapping]` as a reserved section (not coerced into JiraConfig or warned under REBAR_CONFIG_UNKNOWN_KEYS=error) and read raw via read_reserved_section
Axis maps (status_map, type_map, link_map, priority_map, create_defaults) must deep-merge per key with precedence: built-in ← default ← projects.<KEY>, allowing unnamed keys to inherit

Vocabulary declarations (statuses, issue_types, link_types, hierarchy) must replace wholesale by layer (most-specific wins, not unioned), so a project's declared vocabulary fully supersedes default vocabulary

Validation must fail closed offline with MappingConfigError when an axis-map value is absent from declared vocabulary, a sub-table is malformed (non-mapping, non-string value, or non-string list), or a capability-absent axis is referenced
A Capability descriptor dataclass must declare which axes a target's vocabulary has (has_types, has_transitions, has_hierarchy, has_link_types, has_priorities) to gate axis configuration
The module must be provider-neutral, importing no adapters.jira* code and containing no Jira literals, with concrete backends injecting defaults and capability values through the vendor-adapter seam
